# CNN

> > CNN is a leading global news network delivering breaking news, in-depth reporting, and analysis on US and world events, politics, entertainment, law, and current affairs.

CNN provides comprehensive 24/7 news coverage across multiple platforms, featuring regional reporting, investigative journalism, and specialized programming like CNN WorldView. The network covers major political figures, international conflicts, entertainment industry news, and legal developments with dedicated sections for different news categories.

## Key Topics

- Breaking news and current events
- US politics and Trump administration coverage
- International conflicts (Iran, Israel)
- Entertainment and Oscars coverage
- Law, courts, and criminal justice
- Celebrity legal cases and crime news
- Regional US news coverage
- AI and deepfakes technology
- Streaming video content
- Global affairs and diplomacy
- Sports (Team USA, World Baseball Classic)
- Investigative journalism
- Human interest stories

## Main News Hub

- [Breaking News, Latest News and Videos | CNN](https://us.cnn.com/): CNN homepage with breaking news on US, world, politics, and entertainment

## News Categories

- [Law News - Courts, Celebrity Docket, and Crime News from CNN.com](https://us.cnn.com/LAW/index.html): CNN law section covering courts, crime, and celebrity legal cases

## Regional Coverage

- [CNN.com - Local News - U.S./West Region](https://us.cnn.com/LOCAL/west/): Regional news coverage for US West including California and Lake Tahoe

## Programs and Features

- [CNN WorldView](https://us.cnn.com/CNN/Programs/worldview/): CNN WorldView evening newscast program covering global news
- [CNN.com - World Report: Main Page](https://us.cnn.com/WORLD/world.report/): Weekly international features and human interest stories from around world
